meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 为项目接入 Resend 邮件渠道:复制并注册 Resend 适配器,安装固定版本 SDK,提示你配置 Resend 密钥、域名、webhook 并写入 .env,最后把你的邮箱设为所有者并发送一封欢迎邮件。之后你能用电子邮件与机器人对话。
howto.when: 当用户要求把邮件或 Resend 集成进项目时触发;也常见于 /setup 流程中。

say.text: 给项目接入 Resend 邮件渠道
say.note: 开始复制适配器并引导你配置 Resend。

say.text: 用 Resend 加一个邮箱通道,并把我的邮箱设为所有者
say.note: 会把密钥写入 .env 并发送欢迎邮件。

say.text: 帮我接入 Resend 邮件功能,并设置好 webhook
say.note: 引导你完成域名验证和 webhook 配置。

howto.what_en: Adds a Resend email channel to the project: copies and registers the Resend adapter, installs the pinned SDK package, prompts you for Resend credentials/domain/webhook and writes them to .env, then wires your address as owner and sends a hello email. You can then chat with the bot over email.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Resend/email channel to the project, or during a /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to the project.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and guides you through Resend setup.

say_en.text: Add an email channel with Resend and set my address as owner.
say_en.note: Configures .env and emails you a hello.

say_en.text: Set up Resend email and configure the webhook.
say_en.note: Walks you through domain verification and webhook setup.
